## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(bmm)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(here)

source(here("_common.R"))  # shared workshop colors + ggplot theme
```

## Data

<!-- TODO (Adriana): add the perceptual decision-making dataset. Document

     codebooks; do not duplicate column descriptions here. -->

All columns are documented in the codebook: `data/README.md`.

```{r}
#| label: data
#| eval: false
dat <- read.csv(here("data", "ezddm_perceptual.csv"))
glimpse(dat)
```

## Load the fitted model

All workshop models ship pre-fitted in `models/` — nothing to compile,
nothing to wait for:

<!-- TODO (Adriana): once ezddm_summary.rds is committed, remove `eval: false`
     here and in the chunks below so the rendered notebook shows the full
     worked analysis. -->

```{r}
#| label: load-fit
#| eval: false
fit_ez <- readRDS(here("models", "ezddm_summary.rds"))
```
